answers.core: I don't think it's possible to create this feature as a add-on.
answers.workaround:
I think there is a way it can be worked arround, but I don't know of a method at the moment. (In my specific case where it's a tool script)

If it wasn't a tool script then I think this would work:
```gdscript
@export var id: int :
	get:
		return id
	set(value):
		if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
			return
		else:
			id = value
```

title: Allow exported values to be read only
